categories.main_business_segments: Baotou Dongbao Bio-Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the production and sales of gelatin, collagen protein, hollow capsules, and related derivative products. Its business is divided into TO B (business-to-business) segments including pharmaceutical excipients, medical collagen, nutrition and health markets, medical aesthetics, beauty care, and new material applications, and TO C (business-to-consumer) segments featuring 'Collagen+' series nutritional health and beauty products. The company also has a fertilizer business through its subsidiary Dongbao Datian, producing organic and water-soluble fertilizers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in natural collagen extraction and processing, including patented methods for gelatin and collagen peptides. It has developed plasma-derived gelatin for medical applications and employs automated production lines for hollow capsules with high capacity and customization capabilities. The firm maintains comprehensive quality management systems certified by international standards such as NSF-GMP, FSSC22000, ISO9001, and holds European Pharmacopoeia certifications. It also invests in R&D for new products like low-toxin gelatin, antibacterial peptides, and modified gelatin for biomedical uses.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical companies, health and nutrition product manufacturers, medical aesthetics firms, and new material industries such as textiles and energy. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying raw materials and finished products to large pharmaceutical groups like China National Pharmaceutical Group, Huaren Pharmaceutical, Guizhou Bailing, and Qilu Pharmaceutical. Its TO C products target diverse consumer groups across age ranges with nutritional supplements, beauty care, and health foods.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in East China, North China, Central China, South China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. It also has growing export business internationally, with overseas markets contributing to revenue growth. Production facilities are located in Inner Mongolia and Qingdao, with subsidiaries and affiliates in Zhejiang and other provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: Baotou Dongbao Bio-Tech operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the collagen and gelatin supply chain. It produces raw materials like gelatin and collagen peptides, manufactures pharmaceutical excipients such as hollow capsules, and develops end-user products under its 'Collagen+' brand. The company integrates vertically from raw material extraction to finished consumer products, enabling control over quality and innovation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in natural collagen extraction, high-value product development, and expanding applications into medical, aesthetic, nutritional, and new material fields. R&D priorities include developing low endotoxin gelatin, antibacterial collagen peptides, modified gelatin for biomedical use, and specialized collagen for textiles and industrial applications. It pursues a dual innovation model combining in-house research and external collaborations with institutes like the Chinese Academy of Sciences and universities. Digital transformation and precision management also support operational efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of gelatin, collagen protein, hollow capsules, and related derivative products to pharmaceutical, health, and industrial customers. The company also sells branded TO C nutritional and beauty products via online and offline retail channels. Export sales contribute to revenue growth. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on bulk contracts and retail sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Baotou Dongbao Bio-Tech is a leading enterprise in the natural collagen industry in China, with a comprehensive product portfolio and strong brand presence. It competes with other pharmaceutical excipient and collagen producers domestically and internationally. Its subsidiaries like Qingdao Yiqing Bio are recognized leaders in hollow capsule production. The company holds significant market share in gelatin and collagen peptides and is recognized for quality and innovation, maintaining long-term partnerships with major pharmaceutical groups.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 885 million, a 9.19% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 86 million, down 28.28%. It has total assets of around RMB 2.62 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.74 billion. Despite short-term revenue decline due to market and policy factors, the company continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, with ongoing projects to increase hollow capsule production capacity to nearly 70 billion capsules annually. The company maintains a stable financial position with ongoing digital and operational upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive vertical integration in natural collagen production, advanced technology platforms, and strict quality management systems certified by international standards. Its unique value lies in offering high-quality, customizable gelatin and collagen products with broad applications in pharmaceuticals, nutrition, medical aesthetics, and emerging new materials. The 'Collagen+' branded consumer products leverage the company's raw material advantages and industry experience to meet diverse health and beauty needs. Strong R&D capabilities and patented technologies enable continuous product innovation and differentiation in a competitive market.
